newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Escudo could rise against mark - Espirito Santo (ESR).
newsitem.headline: Escudo could rise against mark - Espirito Santo (ESR).

text.p: The escudo has room to rise further against the mark, although its exchange rate will depend heavily on sentiment over Portugal's chances of joining European economic and monetary union from the start, broker Espirito Santo Research (ESR) said.

"In the coming months the escudo could appreciate again to levels below 100 per mark, benefiting from more positive sentiment about the currencies of southern Europe," ESR said in a research document.
"On the other hand, new statements by German officials, questioning the inclusion of Italy, Spain and Portugal in the first wave of EMU, could pressure the peseta and the escudo," it said.
At 1242 GMT, the escudo stood at 100.42/45 per mark. At the fixing of January 20 it stood at an all-time high of 99.365 per mark.
